name: worker-api
description: Public Hono HTTP gateway on Cloudflare Workers; validates requests with shared Zod contracts.

scripts.lint:check: pnpm -w exec cross-env SYNCKIT_TIMEOUT=120000 oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern apps/worker-api
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm -w exec cross-env SYNCKIT_TIMEOUT=120000 oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --fix apps/worker-api
scripts.sentry:deploy: sentry-cli releases set-commits "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" --auto --ignore-missing && sentry-cli releases finalize "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" && sentry-cli deploys new --release "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" --env production
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli releases new "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" --project "$npm_package_name" && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --project "$npm_package_name" --release="$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" --strip-prefix '.cloudflare/output/v0/workers/default/bundle/../../../../../..' .cloudflare/output/v0/workers/default/bundle
